articles.summary: Rigetti announces that it has signed a definitive agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce for an award of $100 million to accelerate R&D projects addressing key technical challenges in scaling and advancing superconducting quantum computers. BERKELEY, Calif., Sept.
articles.title: Rigetti Signs Definitive Agreement for $100M with U.S. Government to Accelerate R&D for Superconducting Quantum Computing
